messages:
Harper Lane: Heads-up 5 planning a compact customer microstory to tie into next week's launch. Need: 15s social clip, 60s highlight, 1-pager, pull quote, and webinar mention.
Diego Morales: I'll fetch the final infra deltas (P95/P99 and token cost) and drop them in the folder. ETA 3pm today.
Nina Rao: I can draft the copy + interview guide. Can we keep the social line qualitative and put %s in the one-pager?
Harper Lane: Yes, social qualitative. One-pager contains metrics and a short methodology note.
Diego Morales: Uploaded: P95 latency -44ms, token cost ~36% lower. File path: /files/benchmarks/microlaunch-APR.
LegalBot: Reminder: customer consent required for quotes and logo use. Use template: "I consent to Redwood Inference using my quote, company name, and logo in marketing materials for this launch. I confirm these materials are not marked or designated as confidential." Capture signer name/title/date.
Nina Rao: Draft pull: "Redwood made our inference predictable and trimmed cost 5 enabling faster feature rollout." Thoughts?
Eli Park: Short and punchy. Customer asked to preview the exact quote before publish. Samira from their side needs the final text by Wed noon.
Harper Lane: Scheduling: can we record Wed 2pm PT (10 mins total: 5 interview + 5 b-roll)?
Diego Morales: Wed 2pm works for infra team to support any tech questions.
SpikeBot: Routing rule proposal: demo leads -> SFDC ENT-311, dedicated interest -> AE-DED, PR -> comms. Add hidden form field deployment_interest and map options.
Harper Lane: Good. Jonas, please confirm SFDC queue with ops and add UTM params: utm_campaign=microstory&utm_source=social.
Diego Morales: Confirmed. I'll add UTM and test webhook post-publish.
LegalBot: After signing, email legal@redwood.ai with signed PDF and include signer name/title/timestamp in the message.
Nina Rao: I'll post the interview brief and two social options by EOD. Harper will finalize.
Harper Lane: Final plan: Nina drafts copy, Diego final numbers, Eli coordinates customer signoff, LaunchBot to kick asset build after signed consent. Everyone react with :white_check_mark: when your item is done.
